feeds.title: Retirement Reflections
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Donna Connolly. Prior to retirement, I lived and worked in Beijing China for fourteen years (Middle School Principal/Deputy Director at The Western Academy of Beijing). Leaving international life behind, my husband and I retired to Vancouver Island in June 2015. To document both this transition and our new adventures, 'Retirement Reflections' was born. I hope that you enjoy these reflections, and will be willing to share your own.
